changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6b item 1: merged service/team-collection/ and service/team-service/ into one service/team/ directory, following the store -> service -> collection direction. Split team-collection/types.ts into types.ts (TeamRecord/TeamCollectionOptions/TeamServiceDeps and the rest of the pure facts, now also holding what was team-service/types.ts minus its submit-result projection) and requests.ts (the Command/MCP-reader functions plus teamSubmitResult/teamSubmitResultOutput, matching the requests.ts template every other domain uses). Moved TEAM_LEADER_REQUIRED_SKILL_SOURCES out of create-request.ts into leader.ts (renamed from leader-agent.ts), and folded read-helpers.ts's matchesTeamHistoryQuery/teamRowMatchesText as private functions into read-model.ts (its one importer), deleting read-helpers.ts. Renamed team-service/index.ts to service.ts, team-collection/mcp-delegate.ts to mcp.ts, and team-service/roster-projection.ts to roster.ts; every other file keeps its current name this item, including the five files (runtime-registry.ts, worktree-cleanup.ts, collaborators.ts, initial-prompt.ts, roster-reader.ts) this stage's later items fold away or delete. No class, type, or exported function was renamed. Updated every importer's module specifier across dispatcher-service/, dispatchers/, scheduler/, server/, cli/, and this directory's own internal relative imports; this is a code-location move only, so behavior, public names, and persisted formats are unchanged. Collapsed the team-collection and team-service .dependency-cruiser.cjs layer entries into one service-team layer, positioned where the two originals sat, and updated the channel-not-to-team-or-teammate and workflow-service-not-to-team named edge rules to the merged path; removed the now-superseded team-service-not-to-team-collection-owner rule (its cross-directory ownership check is intra-directory once the merge lands, and the new direction rule for that follows in a later item, once every file in service/team/ has its final name).
